subject: Confirmation requested on the Section 31 25 00 erosion control requirement for the

messages.text: At Placement Zone 2, the geotechnical report doesn't clearly speak to the Section 31 25 00 erosion control requirement for the disturbed slope area -- can the civil inspector sign off on it as shown? This is routine and can be reviewed during the normal submittal cycle. Please respond within five days so we can schedule the civil inspection.
The compaction and cover requirements are satisfied as shown in Civil Detail 2/C501; no design change is needed for the Section 31 25 00 erosion control requirement for the disturbed slope area.
